runtime.server: SMP reference server and separate same-PC demo server; no server-side timings captured

method.capture: 10 included F3+L captures: 4 STM stress, 4 populated SMP, 2 demo superflat Overworld; 1 accidental dimension capture excluded
method.fps: rendered frame count divided by profile wall duration; duration is rounded to milliseconds by Minecraft
method.percentile: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*N)-1], using every ticktime CSV sample converted from ns to ms
method.timing_scope: instrumented client CPU frame-loop samples, not display presentation or GPU execution time
limitations: Reference scenes differ in terrain, entities, camera and server; not a controlled measurement of STM overhead
One superflat Overworld capture per view distance; two per setting in the other scenarios
STM stress pairs used different mod versions; 25-chunk stress used local development build 0.3.0, not downloadable 0.2.3
Camera pose, traversal, mesh readiness and active shader-pack state not independently recorded
Short CPU-loop profiles do not establish presentation-based 1% lows, GPU execution time or server TPS/MSPT
method.pooled_percentiles: Calculated from concatenated samples within each scenario/view group; never averaged from per-capture percentiles
method.cpu_derived_lows: 1000 / mean of the slowest ceil(N * fraction) CPU-loop samples in ms, for fractions 0.01 and 0.001; pooled groups concatenate samples first. Not display-presentation 1%/0.1% lows.
method.cpu_loop_timeline: Group samples by floor(cumulative preceding sampled CPU-loop duration / 1000 ms). Bin FPS = sample count / summed sampled loop seconds. Time is approximate sampled elapsed time, not wall timestamps. Final partial bin retained; runs remain separate.
method.heap_timeline: Join jvm.csv to ticking.csv by @tick. Bin by cumulative preceding sampled loop time in 250 ms intervals; plot duration-weighted mean and min/max envelope. All samples, including the final partial bin, retained. Whole-client Java heap, not total process RAM or STM-only memory.
method.host_cpu: Join cpu.csv to ticking.csv by @tick; duration-weighted mean across all 24 logical CPUs, and duration-weighted mean of the busiest logical CPU at each sample. Host-wide load, including other processes. MC 26.2 CpuStats uses OSHI processor load polling with an approximately 501 ms cache; repeated rows are not independent polls.
method.resource_limits: No process working set, VRAM, allocation rate, GC pause durations or server MSPT in these aggregates. GPU-utilization field was not plotted as hardware utilization: observed values exceed 100% and its backend interpretation was not established.

excluded_captures.reason: Accidental STM-dimension capture, excluded by operator before analysis
